DocForge bundles QPDF 12.4.2
================================

  https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

The bundled Windows package also contains the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime
DLLs shipped by the official QPDF msvc64 build. They are included so qpdf.exe
runs on a clean Windows installation; they are not modified.

QPDF itself contains code and data from third parties. See the licence section
of the QPDF manual for the complete list and notices:
https://qpdf.readthedocs.io/en/stable/license.html
